title: custom ambient
description: It allows you to change the color of the particles and fog.
body:
Custom Ambient  
Custom Ambient is a client-side Fabric mod designed to give you ultimate control over your Minecraft visuals and PvP experience. Whether you want an aesthetic, vibrant atmosphere with animated RGB colors or a clean, distraction-free environment for Crystal PvP, this mod has everything you need.  

✨ Features  
Fully customize your environment with static RGB colors or animated Chroma (RGB) effects. Simply right-click on any color field in the config menu to open the built-in Color Picker!  

Sky Color: Change the color of the sky.  
Fog Color: Customize the fog color to match your aesthetic.  
Weather Colors: Change the color of Rain and Snow particles.  
Effect Colors: Customize the color of potion effect particles.  
Text Colors: Change the inner color and outer shadow color of UI text.  
Custom Font Support: Apply custom fonts via Font ID.  
⚔️ PvP & Performance Utilities  
Custom Ambient isn't just about aesthetics; it comes packed with essential features for competitive players:  

CPvP Mode: Specifically designed for Crystal PvP. Completely removes explosion particles, explosion fire, and damage tilt animations for a crystal-clear screen during combat.  
Disable All Particles: An absolute toggle to disable every single particle in the game, giving you a massive FPS boost and zero visual clutter.  
Low Fire: Reduces the height of the fire overlay when you are burning, ensuring your crosshair and vision are never blocked.  
⚙️ Configuration  
The mod features an easy-to-use, fully featured configuration GUI (requires Mod Menu to access).  

Built-in Color Picker: Right-click any color setting to visually pick your desired color and transparency (Alpha).  
Chroma Toggle: Toggle between static colors and animated RGB with a single click.  
Reset Defaults: A handy button to instantly revert everything back to vanilla settings.  
🌍 Language Support  
Currently supports:  

English (en_us)  
Turkish (tr_tr)  
📦 Requirements  
Fabric API  
Mod Menu (Highly recommended to access the configuration screen)
